x.author: wax_cache
x.body:
Big changes are coming to Wax Cache. 👀

Right now, I think the free tier puts up a wall before you really get to experience what makes the app useful. I want to fix that.

Soon, free users will get access to the full Wax Cache experience — scanning, pricing, selling tools, organization, reports, and more.

The difference will simply be usage.

Free = full access with a monthly limit.
Hobby = remove the limit.

I’d rather let you experience the product first and decide if it’s worth paying for.
